text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali and former French prime minister Pierre Mauroy underline need to reinforce Europe's policy in the Mediterranean.
- National commission in charge of social dialogue follow-up discusses measures to improve status of public sector doctors.
- The European Union ambassador in Rabat Lucio Guerrato says economic upgrading does not depend only on funds but first on the right way to use them.
- United Nations Secretary-General Kofi Annan says he appointed former U.S. secretary of state James Baker as special envoy in Western Sahara in attempt to break deadlock over referendum proceedings.
- Mourad Cherif, director of state-owned phosphates utility Office Cherifien des Phosphates (OCP) stresses need to market products abroad to consolidate position.
- EU-Moroccan joint fisheries commission to meet in Rabat in late May to assess developments of fish accord.
